commands: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== CU USBMODEM ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbmodem* 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== TTY USBMODEM ==='; ls -l /dev/tty.usbmodem* 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== CU USBSERIAL (NAMES ONLY; DO NOT OPEN) ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbserial* 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== TTY USBSERIAL (NAMES ONLY; DO NOT OPEN) ==='; ls -l /dev/tty.usbserial* 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== USB DESCRIPTORS (READ-ONLY IOREG; NO SERIAL PORT OPEN) ==='; ioreg -p IOUSB -l -w 0 | grep -E 'USB Serial|USB JTAG|Espressif|CP210|CH34|FTDI|idVendor|idProduct|USB Product Name|USB Serial Number' || true
